name: waypost-dev
description: Development and test environment for the Waypost WordPress plugin.

scripts.seed: wp-env run cli wp eval-file bin/seed.php
scripts.seed:divi: wp-env run cli wp eval-file bin/seed.php divi
scripts.reset: wp-env clean all && npm run seed
scripts.lint:php: wp-env run cli bash -c 'find wp-content/plugins/waypost wp-content/plugins/waypost-pro -name "*.php" -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v "No syntax errors" || true'
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp plugin is-installed plugin-check || wp plugin install plugin-check; wp plugin activate plugin-check --quiet; wp plugin check waypost; status=$?; wp plugin deactivate plugin-check --quiet; exit $status'
scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/waypost.zip && zip -qr dist/waypost.zip waypost -x '*.DS_Store' && echo 'dist/waypost.zip ready'
scripts.zip:pro: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/waypost-pro.zip && zip -qr dist/waypost-pro.zip waypost-pro -x '*.DS_Store' && echo 'dist/waypost-pro.zip ready'
